{{Quote|There's an ocean planet&hellip; home to Nautolans. Glee Anselm.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] tracing [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] through the Force|audio=HomeOfNautolans-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
The [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] assigned the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] the '''mission''' to capture four [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] children documented in the holocron. Bane's first choice was the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] child [[Zinn Toa/Legends|Zinn Toa]], who lived on the Nautolan homeworld [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]].

The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] decided to not send a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] peacekeeper to defend Toa, as they concluded that Bane's work on Anselm was impossible to prevent. Despite Bane's success, the child was later reclaimed on the volcanic mining world [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].

==Prelude==
[[File:Glee_Anselm_NEGAS.jpg|thumb|200px|[[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]], homeworld of the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]].]]
{{Quote|I have delivered what you wanted; the Jedi were no problem. Anything else I can help you with?"''<br />''"I need test subjects. Four small children and bring them to Mustafar. I will take care of them."''<br />''"Kidnapping innocent children? Seems like a small-time crime for the likes of you."''<br />''"Among the children of the Jedi, there are no innocents."''<br />''"Sure, sure. As long as I get paid, it makes no difference to me.|Cad Bane and Sidious, discussing Bane's next mission.|audio=INeedTestSubjects-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
Following the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|successful raid on]] the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] performed by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], considered to be the most efficient [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], began to rely on Bane for his own personal use, tasking Bane with [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stealing]] a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="Holocron Heist">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref> and the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|capture]] of [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] and the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], a list of every single [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] child in the galaxy, on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. Following the bounty hunter's success with combining the crystal and holocron, Bane killed the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] and used Denal's armor as a disguise to flee from the scene.<ref name="Cargo of Doom">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref>

Upon arrival at the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], Bane's disguise was compromised and he made his escape in a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]]. Bane was rewarded with the advanced [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|''Xanadu Blood'']], for his actions, and [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] gave him a new mission: capture four of the Force-sensitive infants on the list and deliver them to the remote planet of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where Sidious planned to use them as test subjects in his experiments for the alteration of Force-sensitives to build his own personal corps of [[Spy/Legends|spies]].<ref name="Children of the Force" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|You are certain there is no child on Glee Anselm?"<br />"Into the shadow of the dark side, taken the child was. Shrouded is his fate from us.|Mace Windu and Yoda|audio=NoChildOnGleeAnselm-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
Using the [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|''Xanadu Blood'']], the heavily-modified and well-equipped [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class starfighter]]<ref name="Ep Guide 203">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode203.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Children of the Force}}</ref> that had been gifted to him by Sidious, Bane traveled to the water world of [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]], where he successfully captured the young [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Zinn Toa/Legends|Zinn Toa]].<ref name="Children of the Force" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Zinn_Toa.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] holding Zinn Toa after his rescue from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droids]].]]
{{Quote|Great the loss is, but more children in danger, there are.|Yoda|audio=GreatTheLossIs-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
Cad Bane was able to escape Toa, the first out of the four children he needed to complete his mission, and brought Toa to the Sith's secret stronghold on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. His next target was [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] child of [[Mahtee Dunn/Legends|Mahtee Dunn]]. A collaborative effort between [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] traced Bane's actions through the force, and concluded that he had already succeeded he mission on Anselm, and there was no need to send a Jedi there to protect the child. Kenobi was sent to Rodia while Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were sent to Naboo to protect another child, [[Roo-Roo Page/Legends|Roo-Roo Page]].<ref name="Children of the Force" />

Sidious's installation on Mustafar was eventually uncovered, and Skywalker and his Padawan Tano traveled to Mustafar to rescue Dunn and Toa.<ref name="Children of the Force" /> Since the Jedi were unsure of the full extent of what the children were subjected to on Mustafar, the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] chose not to return the children to their parents and instead to raise the children in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for the time being.<ref name="comment">{{SW|url=video/children-of-the-force-episode-featurette|text="Children of the Force" Episode Featurette}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] homeworld of Glee Anselm was included in early drafts of "[[Children of the Force]]." The scene originally called for the Jedi to return Toa to his home following his rescue on Mustafar. However, director [[Dave Filoni]] cut the scene from the final script, clarifying that the Jedi did not return the children to their respective families, and instead brought the children back to the Jedi Temple.<ref name="comment" />
